body.summary: New vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-outbox.ts (sc5, pure, vscode-free): OutboxRow, OutboxView (runningChat, blockedBy, note), OutboxAction and projectOutbox(rows, sessionId, { titleOf, here?, note? }). Positions are 1-based among every queued/retrying row; processing (and done) rows never appear; failed/not-delivered rows have no position; aheadFromOtherChats counts other chats' waiting rows before this chat's first waiting row (all of them when it has none); runningChat names another chat's processing row ('another chat' when untitled; here from ctx.here); blockedBy comes from that row's waitingOn; attempts>0 and nextAttemptAt pass through for s4. protocol.ts: HostToWebview gains { type:'outbox', view }, WebviewToHost gains OutboxAction; HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES adds 'outbox' and WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES adds the four outbox-* types. The protocol tests assert inclusion, not exact lists, so none needed changing; a new named test pins the additions. Mutations (ahead counting every other row, keeping processing rows, naming the shown chat as running, ignoring here) each fail a test. Plugin suite: 1295 tests, 1285 pass, 8 skipped, 2 fail (pre-existing manifest-catalog). Typecheck clean.
